writeup: TIC 257817337 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 10.970675 days and a primary eclipse depth of 0.17 percent. The candidate was detected in automated TESS photometry with a signal-to-noise ratio of 28.2 using the Box Least Squares algorithm. Pixel-level analysis confirmed the signal, though the centroid offset of 17.6 arcseconds from the target warrants further investigation. No secondary eclipse was detected. The system does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a previously unknown object. However, a notable data quality flag indicates that alternating eclipses differ significantly in depth, suggesting the true orbital period may be twice the initially detected value.
